purpose: Twelve-variant super-good-enough source hunt: genuinely additional measurement-channel and installation-calibration records, explicit separation of historical measurements from nominal ratings and later flight-simulator benchmarks. Source-only; no aerodynamic solver changes.

sources.report: Wright Field Eng-47-1706-A, 4 February 1944, original performance flight report
sources.location: Part VI.A, airspeed calibration table: cockpit IAS, water-column airspeed, calibrated airspeed, installation error, altimeter error; original speed table calibration begins 150 mph IAS.

sources.report: Flugbericht Fw 190/619 Nr. 5, 24 February 1943; original factory comparative flight trial
sources.location: Results 1–2 and original graphs, wing-rack/auxiliary-tank position error and drag. Different engine/airframe from WNr783.
Printed pp.2–3 tabulated nominal aircraft/performance/engine specifications; pp.5–8 actual handling and IAS stall flights; printed p.7 says no performance climbs attempted.

sources.aircraft: Bf 109 F-4, IL-2 Great Battles model; NOT an original 1940s flight test
sources.report: IL-2 Sturmovik official museum published simulation reference
sources.location: Specifications, engine modes, reference loading 2890kg, published maximum performance turn at 270km/h IAS at sea level and 3000m, emergency power.

sources.aircraft: Chance Vought F4U-4, NACA 1947 trial, serial not matched to BuNo 80765
sources.report: NACA RM A7C05, Measurements in Flight of the Flying Qualities of a Chance Vought F4U-4 Airplane
sources.location: Abstract and original report: low-altitude and limited 25,000ft flying-qualities tests; stall warning unsatisfactory in straight/turning flight; separate aircraft, not an independent 80765 CAS series.

series.source_location: Eng-47-1706-A Part VI.A; original table, 150–360 mph cockpit IAS
series.conditions: Original P-38J installation, Kollsman D-2 pitot; CAS provided explicitly for 150–360mph. Original report's stalling speeds are instrument-corrected IAS, not necessarily fully position-corrected CAS. This chart does NOT cover the approximately 53–99mph P-38J stalls and is NOT transferable to P-38G by default.

Original text: auxiliary tanks under the pitot increase under-reading by an additional 6–7km/h. This is a between-configuration error, NOT a full IAS-to-CAS correction, NOT a low-speed chart, NOT a zero-error claim for WNr783.
rows: auxiliary tanks vs same aircraft without auxiliary tanks

series.source_location: Flugbericht Fw 190/619 Nr.5, Result 2, sea level and critical altitude statement
series.conditions: Combat power; speed loss relative to baseline as reported in original. Does not isolate parasite drag independently of installed/cooling/prop differences and does not apply to clean WNr783.

series.source_location: AAF report printed p.3, 'Power Available' section; reported Ha-45 Model 21 ratings
series.conditions: Reported engine specification horsepower, not measured shaft torque on T-2 and not guaranteed as-installed at flight test weight or fuel condition; separate normal/military/WEP.

series.source_location: AAF printed p.2 summary normal/overload; printed p.5 actual test takeoff mass
series.conditions: Actual FLIGHT TAKEOFF 7900lb, catalogue normal fighter 7940lb, catalogue overload 9194lb; 7900 is not instantaneous stall weight after fuel burn. Do not conflate the three.

series.source_location: AAF report printed p.8, power-on clean 60-degree-bank 3G-estimated turning trial
series.conditions: At 8000ft pressure altitude, 2200rpm and a report-stated 20inHg; pilot reported severe buffet and ceased the turn at 130mph IAS. This is NOT a demonstrated 130mph stall, NOT a measured maximum sustained turn rate, and 3G was estimated.

Report explicitly: no performance climbs were attempted because of flying-time restrictions. Its printed p.2 speed and climb figures are descriptive factual/specification tables, not independent measured speed/climb curves of T-2. Do not count nominal figures as measured validation rows.
rows: No performance climb attempted; original 11.5 flight hours only for handling comments

series.aircraft: Bf 109 F-4 (modern IL-2 Great Battles reference model only)
series.source_location: Official IL-2 aircraft-museum performance data: 'Maximum performance turn', notes 2–4
series.conditions: Emergency power, standard 2890kg in IL-2, 270km/h indicated, ISA; game's 20.3/26.1s maximum-performance turns, not actual measured 1940s flight tests. Cross-validation target only, must not raise historical CAS or independent-historical-turn score.

series.aircraft: F4U-4 separate NACA test specimen (not identified as BuNo 80765)
series.source_location: NACA RM A7C05, 1947, original report abstract
series.conditions: Stalling characteristics deemed unsatisfactory in both straight and turning flight because of inadequate warning, but recovery normal. Does NOT provide same-80765 speed or power/turn performance; this is useful independent qualitative corroboration only.
